script: d=$(mktemp -d); waitstop(){ for q; do /bin/sh -c 'while [ -e /proc/$1/stat ]; do read a b s r < /proc/$1/stat; [ "$s" = T ] && exit; sleep 0.001; done' sh "$q"; done; }; set -m; /bin/sh -c 'echo $$ > "$1/a"; kill -STOP $$; exit 3' sh "$d" | /bin/sh -c 'echo $$ > "$1/b"; kill -STOP $$; exit 7' sh "$d" & p=$!; until [ -s "$d/a" ] && [ -s "$d/b" ]; do sleep 0.01; done; waitstop $(cat "$d/a") $(cat "$d/b"); o=$(mktemp); jobs -s > "$o"; echo OBS=$(wc -l < "$o"); kill -CONT %1; wait %1; echo OBSfinal=$?; rm -f "$o"; rm -rf "$d"

bash52.output:
[1]+  Stopped                 /bin/sh -c 'echo $$ > "$1/a"; kill -STOP $$; exit 3' sh "$d" | /bin/sh -c 'echo $$ > "$1/b"; kill -STOP $$; exit 7' sh "$d"
OBS=1
[1]+  Exit 7                  /bin/sh -c 'echo $$ > "$1/a"; kill -STOP $$; exit 3' sh "$d" | /bin/sh -c 'echo $$ > "$1/b"; kill -STOP $$; exit 7' sh "$d"
OBSfinal=7
